item.title: Sudha Murty calls for global pact on outer space arms race
item.description: Sudha Murty has called for a legally binding international agreement to prevent an arms race in outer space, stating that outer space belongs to everyone. India has also urged for a binding global pact to achieve this goal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.
